amendment_reason: The campaign must report regular and higher-order endpoints separately, with higher-order nested inside regular rather than replacing it.
purpose: Development-only calibration of frozen raw multimodal search. It establishes endpoint feasibility, not a paper-facing superiority claim.

candidate_bank.construction: deterministic metadata-only sampling before support targets or query payload are read

methods.ebm_program_ranker: main-effect EBM over exactly the compiled program columns
methods.gbm_program_ranker: support-only permutation importance over exactly the compiled program columns
methods.random_program_ranker: seeded uniform ordering of the identical program bank

hidden_evaluator.score_serialization: all four support score vectors are written before query payload access
hidden_evaluator.null_multiplicity: maximum statistic across all 96 candidates per null draw; family-wise empirical p <= 0.05
hidden_evaluator.regular_label: positive B_known gain; bootstrap lower confidence bound > 0; at least 60% positive held-out patients; both B_known max-statistic null p <= 0.05
hidden_evaluator.higher_order_label: regular label plus positive gain and bootstrap lower confidence bound beyond the strongest legal proper-subset decomposition; at least 60% positive held-out patients and both decomposition max-statistic null p <= 0.05

interpretation: A later frozen test-role cache repeats this protocol without changes. Historical and blind-discovery cohorts remain prohibited from model selection and calibration.
